cases.name: Yessenia Gabriella Norman
cases.about: She had been living at a transitional facility that is contracted with the Arizona Department of Child Safety. Yessenia was ready to start classes at Glendale Community College the day after she was last seen.
cases.narrative:
On 1/28/2026, she was found dead at an apartment in Tolleson, AZ. He allegedly stabbed her 27 times. Her body was mutilated, and covered in blankets and towels. Evidence indicates she was murdered between 2am-4am on 1/16/2026.

Ring video from the night of Jan. 15 shows Norman leaving the transitional home she was living at. Per friends, she was meeting with someone she met on a dating app.
